title: Vaaki Va Swihondzo
intro: Enkarhini lowu hundzeke khale, ku pfuke nhluvuko wa matimba, lowu hambanisiweke hi swiendlo swa wona leswi hlamarisaka swa ku aka ni matimba ya wona lama chavisaka. Ntlawa lowu wa nhlengeletano wu nyikiwe swilo swo tala ni vutshila bya miri, hambiswiritano wu hlawule ndlela yo kaneta rungula ra Xikwembu leri rhumeriweke leswaku ri va kongomisa. Mhaka ya vona yi tirha tanihi dyondzo leyikulu eka tibuku ta matimu, vumbhoni bya vuyelo bya ku ala ntiyiso.
clues: Hi nyikiwe matimba lamakulu swinene ya miri ni ku leha, ku hambana ni vanhu van’wana va le nkarhini wa hina.
A hi tiveka hi ku aka miako leyikulu ni tiphuphu leti tlakukeke endhawini yin’wana ni yin’wana leyi tlakukeke, hi ehleketa leswaku hi ta hanya hilaha ku nga heriki.
Murhumiwa loyi a humaka exikarhi ka hina u rhumeriwe ku ta hi tsundzuxa, a hi vitana leswaku hi gandzela Allah ntsena ni ku tshika swifaniso swa hina.
Hi ku tikukumuxa hi vutise murhumiwa wa hina, hi vutisa loko va tile eka hina ntsena ku ta hi endla hi gandzela Allah ni ku tshika leswi vakokwa wa hina a va swi gandzela.
Tiko ra hina a ri katekisiwe hi mintanga, swihlovo ni masimu lama noneke, kambe hi vule leswaku ku humelela ka hina ku vangiwa hi matimba ya hina, ku nga ri hi Muvumbi wa hina.
Hikwalaho ka ku nga tshembi ka hina loku phikelelaka ni ku hlekula, eku heteleleni hi herisiwile hi moya lowu chavisaka, lowu hlundzukeke lowu a wu ri karhi wu pfurha masiku yo tala ni vusiku.

arabic: فَأَمَّا عَادٌۭ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَقَالُوا۟ مَنْ أَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةً ۖ أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَهُمْ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةًۭ ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا يَجْحَدُونَ
verse: As for ʿAad, they were arrogant upon the earth without right and said, "Who is greater than us in strength?" Did they not consider that Allāh who created them was greater than them in strength? But they were rejecting Our signs. (41:15)
